items.title: ClawShield – Open-source firewall for agent-to-agent AI communication
items.raw_excerpt:
Hi HN! I built ClawShield after discovering 40,214 OpenClaw instances exposed with critical CVE-2026-25253 (CVSS 8.8). The problem: AI agents communicate with each other at scale, but there's NO firewall between them. A compromised agent can inject prompts, exfiltrate data, and hijack WebSocket sessions. ClawShield sits between agents and blocks:
- Prompt injection (16+ patterns)
- Malicious skills/plugins (AST + sandbox)
- Credential leaks (regex + entropy)
- Unauthorized agent-to-agent comms
- WebSocket hijacking Built it last night. 181 tests. Production-ready. Open source (AGPL-3.0). GitHub: https://github.com/DEFNOISE-AI/ClawShield
Demo: [coming soon] Compatible with OpenClaw, AutoGPT, or any agent protocol. Free tier for personal use, paid for teams/enterprise. Would love your feedba

items.title: The first signs of burnout are coming from the people who embrace AI the most
items.raw_excerpt: Because employees could do more, work began bleeding into lunch breaks and late evenings. The employees' to-do lists expanded to fill every hour that AI freed up, and then kept going.

title_i18n.en: The first signs of burnout are coming from the people who embrace AI the most
title_i18n.zh: 最先出现倦怠迹象的正是那些最积极拥抱人工智能的人。
title_i18n.es: Los primeros indicios de agotamiento profesional provienen de quienes más adoptan la inteligencia artificial.

excerpt_i18n.en: Because employees could do more, work began bleeding into lunch breaks and late evenings. The employees' to-do lists expanded to fill every hour that AI freed up, and then kept going.
excerpt_i18n.zh: 由于员工能够承担更多工作，任务开始侵占午餐休息和深夜时间。员工的任务清单不断扩展，填满了人工智能节省出的每一小时，并持续增加。
excerpt_i18n.es: Como los empleados podían hacer más, el trabajo empezó a invadir los descansos para comer y las últimas horas de la tarde. Las listas de tareas de los empleados se ampliaron para ocupar cada hora que la IA liberaba, y luego siguieron creciendo.
